title: WHAT IF YOUR SHADOW WAS 3 SECONDS LATE?

segments.line: You jump. You land. Then your shadow jumps. You
trip on the stairs. You get back up. Your shadow is still falling. You
wave at your crush. She waves back. Your shadow waves. Three seconds later.
What if your shadow was always three seconds behind you?
At first, it's the best party trick ever. You dance, and your shadow does the replay. Your friends lose it.
Here's the thing. Shadows are already made of old light. Sunlight is eight minutes old when it hits you. That's real. Yours is just a little older.
Then a man in a suit knocks on your door. He wants to study it.
And one morning, it happens. Your shadow moves first.
It reaches for your little sister. And you haven't moved at all.
Part one. Would you follow your shadow, or run? Tell me in the comments.
